name: Women Body
overview: Scripture honors the woman’s body as a sacred vessel through which life is given, emphasizing that children are a heritage and reward from the Lord. The Lord’s intimate knowledge and sanctification of a person even before birth reveal the divine purpose and value placed on life formed in the womb. True worth in a woman transcends outward beauty, as favor is fleeting, but reverence for the Lord brings enduring praise and strength. A virtuous woman is esteemed far above precious gems, clothed with strength and honor, reflecting the godly character that Scripture commends.
